data_fields.name: minDeltaS
data_fields.donor_constant: MinDelta, seconds between completions (Quest.cs 24; unit inferred from unix-second arithmetic at QuestManager.cs 353-357)

data_fields.name: cooldownScale
data_fields.donor_constant: quest_mindelta_rate, default 1.0, scales every MinDelta except ColoArena* names

best_idea: A quest solve is one server-side gate with a per-character record and a catalogue cooldown and max-solves cap, which a zone can declare as data.
decision_why: Take the gate shape (catalogue cooldown and max solves, one record, one gate function) for zone quests and chest/item gates; drop the bit-field reuse and the emote-branch dialogue engine, which would be a second rule engine against one engine.
acceptance: Server test with rule {minDelta 3600 s, maxSolves 2}: first solve succeeds; at +60 s refused with 3540 s remaining; at +3600 s succeeds; at +10000 s refused as max-solves; the quest chest reply shows the remaining time, not a silent fail.
